scope: Official Shopify Broadcast:Stellar preset listing View demo inspected read-only via rendered browser accessibility tree for home and Sunscreen collection only. Browser connector disconnected before PDP/cart. No shopper controls, screenshot, viewport/mobile, editor, checkout, keyboard or performance testing.

sources.observation: Official Shopify Broadcast:Stellar listing View demo opened broadcast-stellar.myshopify.com.

claims.observed: Sun-care home connects seasonal hero and SPF messaging with sunscreen/lotion routes; the 11-product collection spans lotions, gels, sprays and bundles and shows price/availability, sorting and pagination cues.
claims.risk: No sort, pagination or product controls tested; SPF, health, ingredient and dermatology statements are seller copy and unverified.
claims.vsn_guard: Support discovery by format and SPF, and substantiate product protection and ingredient claims with appropriate evidence.

claims.observed: Footer explicitly states the storefront is a theme demo and products are not for sale.
claims.risk: PDP and cart were not inspected; no purchase functionality should be inferred from the collection display.
claims.vsn_guard: Keep demonstration status clear and avoid assuming product or checkout claims represent a live merchant.
